subject: maths
title: Geometric & Fibonacci Sequences
welcome_lead: Beyond adding, some sequences multiply or follow special patterns. Meet geometric and Fibonacci.
meta_desc: Explore geometric sequences and Fibonacci numbers in this KS3 adventure.
final_note: Superb! Sequences of all kinds now make sense.

concepts.def: Sequence where each term is multiplied by a ratio.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Sequence 2, 6, 18, 54,. multiplies each term by 3.

Common ratio = 3. Next term: 54 × 3 = 162.

The sequence 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32,. doubles each time.

Common ratio = 2. This is the same as 2⁰, 2¹, 2², 2³.

Start with 1, 1. Each next term = previous two added.

1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, 34,.

The pattern appears in nature, like sunflower spirals.
